info.title: CaseCheck Foundation API
info.description: Synthetic data only. KYC foundation (3 checks) and a multi-agent SME credit workflow: agents prepare and recommend, humans decide on authority levels.

get.description: Server-sent events: `step` for each new timeline step, `run` on status changes, `end` once the run rests.

post.description: Demo: the client uploads the requested documents through the portal (files from the case fixture).
The client finished uploading through another channel: resume the agents on what arrived.
Demo safety test: a forbidden action is submitted to the guard exactly as a compromised planner would.
